rejected.text: Adagia is a world of Sothera, also called Adawa, mentioned as a base of the Sunstar Free Company.
Pages describe it variously as a windy world and main base of the Sunstar Free Company, a world of mirrors and Palatinate colony, and a Summist colony under mirrorscapes.
The material records no events for Adagia; its latest mention calls it a Summist colony under mirrorscapes.
